hooks.command:
LOGFILE=/tmp/kraken_session_actions.log; CHANGELOG=/workspaces/Drabricks_Cloud_Integration/ai_trading/kraken_ai_trading/CHANGELOG.md; if [ -s "$LOGFILE" ]; then date_str=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); printf '
## %s
' "$date_str" >> "$CHANGELOG"; while IFS= read -r cmd; do printf -- '- [CMD] %s
' "$cmd" >> "$CHANGELOG"; done < "$LOGFILE"; rm -f "$LOGFILE"; fi
